canvas.$description: Use as the foundational background of a page or application.

surface.$description: Use for standard structural containers such as cards, panels, and content sections.

backdrop.$description: Use behind modal dialogs, drawers, and other blocking overlays to dim underlying content.

fill.$description: Use these colors for bounded filled elements according to their prominence and meaning.

$root.$description: Use for default high-prominence filled elements such as primary buttons, strong badges, or prominent actions.

hover.$description: Use when a default high-prominence filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a default high-prominence filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for high-prominence filled elements that require a neutral treatment.

hover.$description: Use when a neutral high-prominence filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a neutral high-prominence filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for high-prominence filled elements that communicate neutral information or guidance.

hover.$description: Use when an informational high-prominence filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while an informational high-prominence filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for high-prominence filled elements that trigger or communicate a negative action or outcome.

hover.$description: Use when a negative high-prominence filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a negative high-prominence filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for high-prominence filled elements that trigger or communicate a positive action or outcome.

hover.$description: Use when a positive high-prominence filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a positive high-prominence filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for lower-prominence filled elements such as secondary buttons, neutral chips, or subtle selected states.

hover.$description: Use when a neutral lower-prominence filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a neutral lower-prominence filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for lower-prominence filled elements that communicate neutral information or guidance.

hover.$description: Use when an informational lower-prominence filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while an informational lower-prominence filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for lower-prominence filled elements that warn about a potential issue requiring attention.

hover.$description: Use when a warning lower-prominence filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a warning lower-prominence filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for lower-prominence filled elements that communicate an error, unfavorable outcome, or negative consequence.

hover.$description: Use when a negative lower-prominence filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a negative lower-prominence filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for lower-prominence filled elements that communicate success, a favorable outcome, or positive confirmation.

hover.$description: Use when a positive lower-prominence filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a positive lower-prominence filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use when a default bounded element intentionally has no visible fill and should reveal its parent background.

hover.$description: Use when a default ghost filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a default ghost filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use when a neutral bounded element intentionally has no visible fill and should reveal its parent background.

hover.$description: Use when a neutral ghost filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a neutral ghost filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use when an informational bounded element intentionally has no visible fill and should reveal its parent background.

hover.$description: Use when an informational ghost filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while an informational ghost filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use when a negative bounded element intentionally has no visible fill and should reveal its parent background.

hover.$description: Use when a negative ghost filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a negative ghost filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use when a positive bounded element intentionally has no visible fill and should reveal its parent background.

hover.$description: Use when a positive ghost filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a positive ghost filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for selected controls and progress indicators that require a distinct accent fill.

hover.$description: Use when a selected accent-filled interactive element is hovered.

active.$description: Use while a selected accent-filled interactive element is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for the completed or selected portion of a slider track.

hover.$description: Use for the completed portion of a slider track when the slider is hovered.

active.$description: Use for the completed portion of a slider track while the slider is actively manipulated.

$root.$description: Use for the unselected background track of a slider.

hover.$description: Use for the unselected slider track when the slider is hovered.

active.$description: Use for the unselected slider track while the slider is actively manipulated.

endstop.$description: Use for markers at the ends of a slider track.

$root.$description: Use for the checkbox container when it is not selected.

hover.$description: Use for an unselected checkbox container when it is hovered.

active.$description: Use for an unselected checkbox container while it is actively pressed.

selected.$description: Use for the checkbox container when it is selected.

$root.$description: Use for the radio container when it is not selected.

hover.$description: Use for an unselected radio container when it is hovered.

active.$description: Use for an unselected radio container while it is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for the radio container when it is selected.

hover.$description: Use for a selected radio container when it is hovered.

active.$description: Use for a selected radio container while it is actively pressed.

$root.$description: Use for the switch track when it is off.
Use for the switch track when it is on.

knob.$description: Use for the movable knob inside a switch track.

border.$description: Use these colors for boundaries, dividers, and status outlines according to their prominence and meaning.

$root.$description: Use for default boundaries and dividers that require clear visual separation.

secondary.$description: Use for subtle decorative boundaries and dividers. Do not use when the boundary is the only visual cue identifying a control.

information.$description: Use for boundaries around elements that communicate neutral information or guidance.

warning.$description: Use for boundaries around elements that warn about a potential issue requiring attention.

negative.$description: Use for boundaries around elements that communicate an error, unfavorable outcome, or negative consequence.

positive.$description: Use for boundaries around elements that communicate success, a favorable outcome, or positive confirmation.

focusRing.$description: Use these colors for visible keyboard-focus indicators according to the focused element's status.

$root.$description: Use for the default visible keyboard-focus indicator around an interactive element.

warning.$description: Use for the visible keyboard-focus indicator around an element in a warning state.

negative.$description: Use for the visible keyboard-focus indicator around an element in a negative or error state.

positive.$description: Use for the visible keyboard-focus indicator around an element in a positive or success state.

text.$description: Use these colors for text according to its emphasis, status, or interaction role.

primary.$description: Use for default body copy and interface labels requiring the strongest standard text emphasis.

secondary.$description: Use for supporting text and metadata that should be less prominent than primary text.

information.$description: Use for text that communicates neutral information or guidance.

warning.$description: Use for text that warns about a potential issue requiring attention.

negative.$description: Use for text that communicates an error, unfavorable outcome, or negative consequence.

positive.$description: Use for text that communicates success, a favorable outcome, or positive confirmation.

onPrimaryFill.$description: Use for text placed on primary fills such as prominent filled buttons, chips, or badges.

$root.$description: Use for text placed on secondary fills that have lower visual prominence than primary fills.

information.$description: Use for text placed on secondary fills that communicate neutral information or guidance.

warning.$description: Use for text placed on secondary fills that warn about a potential issue requiring attention.

negative.$description: Use for text placed on secondary fills that communicate an error, unfavorable outcome, or negative consequence.

positive.$description: Use for text placed on secondary fills that communicate success, a favorable outcome, or positive confirmation.

icon.$description: Use these colors for icons according to the same emphasis, status, and interaction roles as text.

primary.$description: Use for default interface icons requiring the strongest standard icon emphasis.

secondary.$description: Use for supporting icons that should be less prominent than primary icons.

information.$description: Use for icons that communicate neutral information or guidance.

warning.$description: Use for icons that warn about a potential issue requiring attention.

negative.$description: Use for icons that communicate an error, unfavorable outcome, or negative consequence.

positive.$description: Use for icons that communicate success, a favorable outcome, or positive confirmation.

link.$description: Use for icons that accompany interactive text links.

onPrimaryFill.$description: Use for icons placed on primary fills such as prominent filled buttons, chips, or badges.

onSelectedFill.$description: Use for icons and indicators placed on selected accent fills.

$root.$description: Use for icons placed on secondary fills that have lower visual prominence than primary fills.

information.$description: Use for icons placed on secondary fills that communicate neutral information or guidance.

warning.$description: Use for icons placed on secondary fills that warn about a potential issue requiring attention.

negative.$description: Use for icons placed on secondary fills that communicate an error, unfavorable outcome, or negative consequence.

positive.$description: Use for icons placed on secondary fills that communicate success, a favorable outcome, or positive confirmation.

indicator.$description: Use for the visible indicator inside a selected checkbox.
Use for the visible indicator inside a selected radio.

logo.$description: Use only in logo artwork. Logos keep these exact colors; do not use them for interface elements.

symbol.$description: Colors of the product symbols. The same in light and dark contexts.

monochrome.$description: Use for every shape of a monochrome logo.
